Name: (VPR)Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn-Additional Compatibility
Author: 1oOwOo1
Description:
[size=3]为[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]（VPR）充满活力的田园着色[/url]增加了额外的季节性地图兼容性。[/size]

[b][color=#ffff00][size=4]目前支持：[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]东斯卡普[/b]（季节性，只适配SVE）[/size]
[*][size=3][b][font=Times New Roman]里奇赛德村[/font][/b]（[/size][size=3]季节性[/size][size=3]）[/size]
[*][size=3][b][font=Times New Roman]阳莓村[/font][/b] (季节性，包括 山谷总是下雨 和 新增NPC瑞普莉，需要搭配[font=Times New Roman][b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33464]Additional Pastoral Redrawn Compatibility[/url]﻿[/b][/font] 使用 )[/size]
[*][size=3][b][font=Times New Roman]雾呜山峰[/font][/b]（季节性）[/size]
[/list]
[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]安装步骤：[/b][/size][/color][size=3]
1.安装所需模组
2.安装我的模组
3.解压并放进Mods文件夹
[/size][color=#ffff00][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][/color][size=3]This is additional seasonal map  compatibility for [b][font=Times New Roman][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn(VPR)[/url][/font][/b].

[b][color=#ffff00]Currently supported:
[/color][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][b][font=Times New Roman]East Scarp[/font][/b]（just for [font=Times New Roman][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/font]）[/size]
[*][size=3][b][font=Times New Roman]Ridgeside Village[/font][/b][/size]
[*][size=3][b][font=Times New Roman]Sunberry Village[/font][/b] (Including [font=Times New Roman][b]Always Raining in the Valley SBV[/b][/font] and [b][font=Times New Roman]Ripley the Farmer[/font][/b], requires [/size][size=3][font=Times New Roman][b][/b][/font][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33464][size=3][font=Times New Roman][b]Additional Pastoral Redrawn Compatibility[/b][/font][/size][size=3][/size][/url]﻿[size=3] )[/size]
[*][size=3][b][font=Times New Roman]Visit Mount Vapius[/font][/b]（All seasons support）[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][color=#ffff00][size=4][b]How to install:[/b][/size][/color][size=3]
1. Install the latest version of the required mod.
3. Install my mod.
4. Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder.[/size]
